text:
Max: Anyone up for a lunchtime micro-challenge tomorrow? 30 min bouldering at CragHouse vs a 3k tempo run around the park? :thinking_face: 
Ava: Ooh tough call. I can only do the run but I will absolutely trash the crag if I make it. :sweat_smile: 
Liam: I vote boulder. Short, intense, and I can still make my 1pm standup. Who's timing?
Priya: I can lead the run. 12:15 meet outside the breakroom, 3k loop. Pace: comfortably hard. No stopping for bagels. :runner:
Sam: If it's raining we pivot to circuit in the small gym — quick AMRAP of kettlebell swings + box step-ups? 
Max: Love the contingency plan. Weather looks 70/20 sun/cloud on the app. If >50% rain we gym it.
Ava: @Priya can you post a short route? I only know the long park loop.
Priya: Sure — quick map: breakroom -> north path -> footbridge -> around the pond -> back. Clockwise, roughly 3k. I'll drop a pin.
Liam: Also can we make it a tiny bet: winner picks dessert at Friday team lunch? :eyes:
Sam: Deal. Loser brings the fancy granola bars. 
Max: hr-bot, add to calendar? :calendar:
hr-bot: "Event created: 'Midday Micro: Run vs Crag' — 12:15 tomorrow, optional. RSVP required."
Ava: RSVP: run (but might cave and boulder).
Priya: RSVP: run.
Liam: RSVP: boulder.
Sam: RSVP: gym fallback.
Max: RSVP: boulder.
Ava: Also, quick heads-up: bring a towel and band aid kit for crag — someone tore a callus last time.
Liam: I'll bring chalk and a tiny first-aid kit.
Max: Nice. See you all tomorrow — may the best midpacker win. :muscle:
